# A remote configured with a shorthand URL (e.g. "gh:owner/repo")
# that Git expands with url.*.insteadOf
# identifies the forge without spice.forge.kind.

as 'Test <test@example.com>'
at '2026-10-21T12:00:00Z'

cd repo
git init
git commit --allow-empty -m 'Initial commit'

shamhub-setup
shamhub register alice
shamhub new origin alice/example.git
git push origin main

# The configured URL does not identify ShamHub;
# only the URL Git rewrites it to does.
git remote set-url origin sh:alice/example.git
git config url.$SHAMHUB_URL/.insteadOf sh:

gs repo init

env SHAMHUB_USERNAME=alice
gs auth login

git add feature.txt
gs branch create feature -m 'Add feature'
gs branch submit --fill
stderr $SHAMHUB_URL/alice/example/change/1

-- repo/feature.txt --
feature
